name: gpt-continuum
description: Keep your GPT moving when ChatGPT says at capacity by sending a configurable follow-up message on a timer.

interface.shortDescription: Keep GPT moving past at-capacity interruptions.
interface.longDescription: When ChatGPT stops at capacity or pauses a long task, start a visible timer that sends a configurable follow-up message to the current conversation. No credentials, conversation scraping, or external data storage.
defaultPrompt: Open GPT Continuum and send a continue message every 60 seconds.
